records.text: An unidentified FBI spokesperson said the agency had recovered what it believed was the weapon used in the shooting: a high-powered bolt-action rifle found in a wooded area where the shooter had fled.
records.speaker: FBI Spokesperson (Ep 2WEHTk0Xewg)

appearances.snippet: This morning I can tell you that we have recovered what we believe is the weapon that was used in yesterday's shooting. ... It is a high-powered bolt-action rifle. ... That rifle was recovered in a wooded area where the shooter had fled.

verification.notes: The FBI's official press conference remarks from September 11, 2025, confirm the recovery of a high-powered bolt-action rifle from a wooded area where the shooter fled, believed to be the weapon used in the shooting of Charlie Kirk at Utah Valley University. This is corroborated by multiple reliable news sources including Reuters, PBS, USA Today, and NBC News, all reporting the same details from the FBI announcement.

sources.title: Remarks Delivered by Special Agent in Charge Robert Bohls at the September 11, 2025, Press Conference Regarding the Shooting At Utah Valley University
